goals.0: The names of the 7 days and 12 months
goals.1: Using am Montag and im Mai
goals.2: Saying a date and a birthday
grammar.0.title: The seven days
grammar.0.intro: All days are masculine: der Montag, der Dienstag… Tap to listen.
grammar.0.note: am + day: am Montag (on Monday), am Wochenende.
grammar.1.title: The twelve months
grammar.1.intro: Months are masculine too: der Januar, der Mai. With im: im Mai (in May).
grammar.2.title: The four seasons
grammar.2.note: im Sommer = in summer, im Winter = in winter.
grammar.3.title: Saying and writing dates
grammar.3.text: German goes day · month · year: 15.05.2025 = “der fünfzehnte Mai”. For events: “am 15. Mai” (on 15 May). Birthday: “Mein Geburtstag ist am 15. Mai.”
quiz.1.why: Mittwoch = Wednesday (the middle of the week).
quiz.4.why: Heute ist Freitag = Today is Friday.
quiz.6.prompt: Put the words in order: “My birthday is on 15 May.”
dialog.2.de.4.n: 15. = the fifteenth (later) — for now: number + dot
